sourceAnchors.expected: 2DGS represents 3D scene surfaces with oriented planar Gaussian disks, not 2D image-only reconstruction. Depth distortion concentrates ray-contributing primitives in a tight depth interval; normal consistency aligns rendered disk normals with normals from rendered depth gradients. Neither term establishes a guarantee of perfect geometry.
